about: A short list of three.js names and import paths that were removed, renamed or added at some revision. Written from memory, so every entry is unverified. The preflight script treats a hit as confirmed only when the installed package itself agrees (the name is absent from its build, or the path is absent from its folder). Re-read the migration guide for the installed revision before relying on an entry.

changes.use: ES modules from three/addons/ or three/examples/jsm/
changes.note: r147 to r148: the examples/js directory has been removed
package.json exports './addons/*' from tag r144; absent at r143 (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r143/package.json). The migration guide does not record the alias.
r151 to r152: WebGLRenderer.outputEncoding has been replaced with WebGLRenderer.outputColorSpace

r151 to r152: sRGBEncoding is now SRGBColorSpace, LinearEncoding is now LinearSRGBColorSpace. sRGBEncoding is still exported in r152 src/constants.js, so the symbol check confirms only on later revisions.

changes.use: outputEncoding and sRGBEncoding on older revisions
changes.note: Half right: outputColorSpace arrives in r152 (migration guide), but SRGBColorSpace is already exported in r150 and r151 src/constants.js, so 'since 152' is wrong for that name. Splitting the entry needs a script change; left unverified.
r124 to r125: Geometry removed from core; the guide lists Face3 under r125 to r126. Neither is imported by src/Three.js at r125.

changes.use: the lighting mode of the installed revision; read its migration notes
changes.note: r149 to r150: physicallyCorrectLights = true is now useLegacyLights = false; r154 to r155 makes useLegacyLights false by default and deprecated.
